test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d13d198e438ab856e1fca73d2ec990c208b886588293dfaff15240f9933c591d.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) For first box alternate series : 

 
• Alternately top left corner element, bottom left corner element and bottom right corner element shifts in the anti-clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately first two elements of second and third column shifts in the anti-clockwise direction. 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c97ab7b7ae7d09b1233f0b1941b025da4cd06de3f83bb27034aa3733ca6f370.png] 

2) For second box alternate series :

 
• Alternately top left corner element, center element, bottom right corner element and center right element shifts in the downward anti-clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately top center element is replaced by new element and remains constant i.e ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45b494fd6a0a29f7ea7a7e56e69310cea1fcb91955c31de82b6b7c0fb42c3c1a.png] ' is replaced by ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02b9b1ddea2d24bceb48b1459fed67ef72bcab5255878adf64e480d5820777f5.png] ' and ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4489fabc46869d01d664597bbfbc20b215ec3c9dcc6cd4f05859d0c5737eb44b.png] ' is replaced by ' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b2ecc9c3094c9ca71a770bd0683e66b53fc3544fe7587c57a85c36b539f1f7ee.png] '.
 
• Alternately bottom left corner element and top right corner element shifts in the downward anti-clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/80f0615de4052400da55a838ed37129bd06e0b5b9c4a97c51e0c0d5d2b8c8904.png] 

The final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1c3164a4f70d3f79244c8671eaea3fadb7d0a4320278c108e1eddd4f4439353.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (4)’ is the correct answer.
